test_title: PYST 15: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Four friends Rati, Areema, Sonali and Geet are sitting side by side on the bed facing towards north. Sonali is sitting towards left of Rati. Rati is sitting to immediate left of Areema. Geet is sitting between Rati and Sonali. Who is sitting at second place from the right end?
solution:
Four friends Rati, Areema, Sonali and Geet are sitting side by side on the bed facing towards north.

1) Rati is sitting to immediate left of Areema and Geet is sitting between Rati and Sonali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff19eece81a3db6b61ab1c53c564fdd1296e90f9e0dc7b9f73230a2e199efafd.png] 

2) Sonali is sitting towards left of Rati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/028bc2b9d85f4ffd72142d58de3156a47643870dc1072839b03a8eb8cc904d9c.png] 

∴ Here, 'Rati' is sitting in second place from right end.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rati".**
